item.title: Car parked on footpath, 25th August
item.description:
Car parked across narrow footpath, finding it quite difficult as my brother is partially sighted, and although it's dry now, when it's wet, it means you have to cross the grass or the road. This will also make it difficult for a number of wheelchair users that live in a respite home a few herses, along from me. Car untaxed and insurance also no number plate although covered it has no plates. No drop pavement.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Hill View Drive, Thamesmead
